page_title: DAR 0-0 MAI | Darmstadt v Mainz 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Mainz fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+1' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) picks up a yellow card.
90+1' Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Robin Zentner makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

88' Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
86' The referee signals a substitution. Aymen Barkok (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Tom Krauss.
83' Ovid Hajou has decided to make a change. Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) replaces Tim Skarke.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) is coming onto the pitch as Oscar Vilhelmsson cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Anthony Caci (Mainz) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
75' 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
73' The foul by Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniel Siebert.
72' Substitution. Phillipp Mwene makes way for Anthony Caci (Mainz).
69' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
66' Jan Siewert has decided to substitute Ludovic Ajorque and he is replaced by Brajan Gruda (Mainz).
61' Substitution. Fraser Hornby (Darmstadt) in, Luca Pfeiffer out.
58' Yellow card! It's like Dominik Kohr (Mainz) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Daniel Siebert agrees and books him.
57' Caution goes to Robin Zentner (Mainz).
51' Danny da Costa (Mainz) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
40' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
35' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniel Siebert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
34' Darmstadt couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Robin Zentner (Mainz) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
33' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Darmstadt.
29' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
25' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
25' The free kick from long range, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Mainz manage to earn a corner.
21' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
20' The ball is cleared after Danny da Costa (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Mainz have a corner.
14' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
13' CLOSE! Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
7' The corner from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is intercepted by the defence.
1' The match has just started.
Mainz will kick-off.
Daniel Siebert got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
